summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend testing. Added 4 new pytest cases (public divisions, public division schedule + 404, analytics auth-gate, analytics enrichment) — all pass. Full Playwright verification of admin Analytics page (4 stat cards, 4 chart panels with recharts, hover tooltips carrying 'lectures / week' + '% utilised'), Divisions copy-link, Student Portal on mobile (picker, search, pick, tab switch, change, localStorage restore) and desktop (direct link, timetable table visible with period times, share link, unknown id -> student-error + picker fallback), landing hero links and public teacher portal's portal-student-link. Regression (Generated timetable + Teachers login badge) OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~598 lines) mixing many concerns; consider extracting analytics/public/documents into APIRouter modules.

GET /api/public/divisions returns ALL divisions in the database (not only demo-*). Fine now, but if real customer data is added it will leak sensitive class rosters on an unauthenticated endpoint — consider gating behind a config flag (e.g. public_portal_enabled) or a per-division public flag.

GET /api/public/division/{id} returns full entry objects including teacher names/emails as-is; ensure no PII (teacher.email/employee_id) is included in entries — currently entries appear to only carry teacher_name/room_name which is OK.
StudentPortal.js reads window.localStorage at useState init — safe in CRA but will break under SSR. Not an issue for current setup, but a hazard if migrated to Next.
AnalyticsView is a single very long JSX line (>3k chars) in Scheduler.js. Hurts readability/reviewability; consider formatting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Iteration 3 tests are named test_public_divisions_no_auth, test_public_division_schedule_ok_and_404, test_analytics_requires_auth, test_analytics_enriched. Analytics tooltip check requires hovering the recharts bar (mouse.move to bar bounding box center); the tooltip lives inside the specific panel's DOM subtree (query with `[data-testid="<panel>"] [data-testid="chart-tooltip"]`). StudentPortal remembers division in localStorage key `smartclassroom.student.division`.
